event_summary: Completed JPMC Lead Software Engineer - JAVA BACKEND (Req 210789874) application. Confirmed on /my-profile, archived submission_confirmation.png and answers.json. Enforced single-line contact header across all resumes and HTML_WRAPPER. Codified Section 1 resume upload protocol into ORACLE_HCM_ATS_DEEP_DIVE.md, COMPANY_ATS_KNOWLEDGE.md, and WORKSPACE_RULES.md (Rule 15). Cleaned up all temporary root scripts.
learned_rules: Section 1 Resume Upload Gate: Never bypass Section 1 without uploading tailored resume PDF and awaiting Profile successfully imported banner.
Single-Line Contact Header Standard: Phone, Email, Location, and LinkedIn must be on a single line in resume markdown and CSS (white-space: nowrap, 8.0pt) to preserve vertical space.
Strict 2-Page Budget: Margin must be 6mm top/bottom, 10mm sides with 8.3pt font and 1.26 line height for exact 2-page A4 PDFs.
Browser Tab Downloader Isolation: In Oracle HCM, never query pages[0] blindly because a hidden downloader tab occupies index 0; always filter for /my-profile or /apply/.
